Mastermind

Mastermind — crack the secret 4-color code in 10 tries with black/white peg feedback.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick 4 colors and press “Check guess”.
  2. Black peg = right color in the right spot.
  3. White peg = right color, wrong spot.
  4. Crack the code within 10 attempts to win.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What do the black and white pegs mean?

A black peg means one of your colors is exactly right (right color, right spot). A white peg means a color is right but in the wrong spot. Pegs are not lined up with specific holes — count them, don't map them.

Can a color appear more than once?

Yes, colors can repeat in the secret code — don't assume four different colors.

Any strategy tips?

Start with four different colors to maximize information, then use the peg counts to eliminate possibilities. Watch out for duplicate-color feedback.
